summary: Added 8 failing unit tests for property filter in view DSL to test/unit/gtd-view-language-test.el. Tests cover: single property match (include/skip/missing), multiple property AND logic (all match/partial match), and input validation (non-list, non-cons entry, non-string name). 6 of 8 tests fail as expected since the property filter is not yet implemented. The 2 passing tests (includes-match, multiple-all-match) pass because without the property predicate, items pass through if the type matches.
